I recomputed z with noise sd 0.0037: (0.3618 - 0.3721) / (0.0037 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) ≈ -2.27. This is consistent with the harness's -2.260; the small gap is likely from rounding of the reported means. The candidate is about 0.010 worse than the incumbent, so 'reject' is correct.
Side note, not about the candidate: the incumbent's final Ridge was fitted on only the last KFold training split, not on all training data. That small flaw is not a reason to accept this candidate.
